candidates.label: dAB (dA + B decoy behind the startup jmp)
candidates.change: A = dA. B: 54-byte dead copy of B[8Fh..0C4h] (phoenix_init from push cs; pop ss through the worker's mov cl,9) inserted between the startup's jmp short phoenix_init and zombie_entry; the existing jmp skips it, so no instruction is added. Only label-derived immediates move (lea bx zombie_entry 39h->6Fh, jmp EB44->EB7A, add si 0B9h->0EFh, sub si 62h->98h). The B decoy is BELOW B's real code, so it absorbs FORWARD searches for those windows. Generator agent2/night/scratch/B086/mkb.cjs.

recommendation: Do not promote on its own: dA is a cheap defense add-on, not a field gain. Screen +0.0036 (below the +0.006 field bar, no negative group); +0.13..+0.20 vs every backward signature counter tested; executed code identical to rev0. Carry it into the next combination where A has room: it needs A's late region (start+04h..template end) duplicated above the real code. That fits rev0/SD-style A, but not E1/K as-is (their A late code is longer), unless the decoy covers only phoenix_init+template. dAB adds forward-search cover but perturbs B's layout (W/L 14/16, ALL +0.0006); keep it documented, do not promote it. Neither variant stops a decoy-aware counter (aware = 0).
